title: Morgan City brass band and nearby bands
summary: Local players combined with Berwick to form a brass band playing parades in surrounding towns; he heard Ezekiel Mack's band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Do you remember any of the other bands when you were even a little kid, six or seven years old when you first started in school? What kind of music did they have around town? Do you remember any? Well, I don't remember, Mr. Bill. Think at all?
No, not at all at that time.
Were there any brass bands in the town that they ever had a parade?
Yes, sir. We had a few fellas there and we used to make up a brass band between the ones that was in Morgan City at the time.

The fellas, they didn't come from New Orleans, they were right there. Right there in Morgan City. Somebody knocking on a shut-up. Okay, we're talking about the brass band, you say the people there in town got together for a brass band sometime too?

We used to go to Boybick, Louisiana, that's across the river from Morgan City. And between the two towns, Morgan City and Boybick, we used to make up a brass band. That's the only way they had a brass band in Morgan City at the time.
About how big was it, do you remember?
How big the band was? Well, Mr. Bill, we used to have around eight, seven and eight fellas playing music at that time.
Remember what instruments they would use on the street?
Well, yes, I do. They used to use clarinet, two trumpets, trombone, and baritone I think you called it, that's right.
Yeah, baritone and pulling.
Yeah, so far as I remember.
Yeah, I know it's hard to remember every little detail. So just whatever you can think of is good.
Yeah, so far as I can remember that.
They have a bass drum and snare drum both? Yes, they had bass drum and snare drum.
Two drummers. Yeah, I used to play snare drum.
How old would you be about then, Sammy? Well at that time I was somewhere around about thirteen years old.
Oh, I see, yeah.
And were all the members of the band about the same age, about that age?
Well, yeah, we was all mostly at that time. Pretty young. Yeah.
And that was, as far as you know, that was about the first band that did that around there, was it?

Well, that was the first band because we used to go to other little towns from Morgan City, like Jennerette, Louisiana, and also Patterson, Louisiana. They didn't have any band at all. They used to get us to come down and play parades on holidays. Yeah, that's right. Which like Fourth of July and different days like that, you know? And you'd play parades? How about dances? Did you ever play any dances? Well, the band that I was playing with, with Jake Johnson, well we used to play dances then, with our orchestra, we had Morgan City.
Were there any other bands before that, do you think, that played for dances? When you were a kid did you ever hear them from outside even?

Well, I did used to hear a band by the name of Ezekiel Mack from Boybick, Louisiana. He had a nice band but he was an older man than I was. I was, well, too young to play in his band. But I used to go down and sit down and listen to them and sit in some time, well they told me I had to go home, I was too young to stay out late at night like that.
